title: mto-extension-vault-enterprise-bootstrap values
description: Constrains only the switches whose values are consumed as string comparisons downstream, where a near-miss (yes / on / True / 1) would otherwise disable an integration silently, plus the token durations VCO takes as integer seconds. Everything else is intentionally unconstrained. The accepted boolean forms mirror templates/_helpers.tpl exactly -- a boolean, or the strings "true"/"false". If you change one, change the other.

boolish.description: true or false, as a YAML boolean or as the quoted string "true"/"false". Anything else (yes, on, off, 1, 0, True, TRUE) is rejected, because it would be read as "not enabled" without warning.

parent.description: Parent Template defaults, passed through to every child TI. REQUIRED: a values file that nulls it deletes the key, and every .Values.parent.<x> read would then nil-pointer the whole render instead of naming the value.

eso.description: A string, not a boolean: "enabled" or "disabled". true/false/yes/on are rejected.

token.description: Tenant chart `token`, install-wide. Integer seconds: VCO's KubernetesAuthEngineRole types these as integers.

tenantValues.description: Install-wide tenant chart values. Validated by the tenant chart's own schema at render time; keys owned by this chart are rejected by the installWideValues helper.

mode.description: Drift protection. Unquoted on/yes/off parse as YAML booleans and are rejected -- quote the value.
